name: Alchemy-Chromium (patched Chromium)
script:
# Chromium source goes beside the patches checkout (own LV: /srv/rack/builds/alchemy-chromium/chromium once mounted).
set -x
mkdir -p /cache/chromium && cd /cache/chromium
[ -f .gclient ] || fetch --nohooks --no-history chromium
gclient sync --nohooks --no-history -D
cd /work/src && python3 apply.py /cache/chromium/src
cd /cache/chromium/src && gn gen out/Release --args='is_debug=false is_component_build=false symbol_level=0 blink_symbol_level=0 enable_nacl=false'
autoninja -C out/Release chrome
mkdir -p /out && tar -C out/Release -cJf /out/alchemy-chromium-linux-x64.tar.xz chrome icudtl.dat resources.pak chrome_100_percent.pak chrome_200_percent.pak v8_context_snapshot.bin locales
